create_SPDataset: create a PyTorch Dataset for single-hop dense retrieval with positive and negative paragraph samples
create_FeverSingleDataset: create a PyTorch Dataset for FEVER claim verification using TF-IDF and linked negative paragraphs
create_NQMhopDataset: create a PyTorch Dataset for multi-hop NQ retrieval with query augmentation via mask tokens
create_MHopDataset: create a PyTorch Dataset for multi-hop retrieval with two positive and two negative paragraphs per sample
use_sp_collate: use the sp_collate function to batch single-hop retrieval samples into padded input tensors
